template: ln S_R^fit = -ln(4 pi^2 alpha0) - 2(1+d)/d + 2 J(d,kappa)/d + c0 + c1 d + q ln C_{nu*}; A=3(1+d)^2, xi=kappa^d, nu*=sqrt(9/4+A xi(1-xi)), u_g=A(1-xi)/(nu*+3/2), J=3+sqrt(A) arctan(u_g/sqrt(A))+(3/2)ln[A/(A+u_g^2)]-A(3+u_g)/(A+u_g^2), ln C_nu=(2nu-3)ln2+2[lnGamma(nu)-lnGamma(3/2)]
normalization: S_R = b^2 M_Pl^2 P_R (dimensionless; tau_B=-1, M_Pl=1 convention of the scan table)
fit_method: minimax (maximum absolute log-error) linear-programming fit of the residual c0 + c1 d + q ln C_nu on the training groups of the grouped (d,kappa) split (seed 1234, 80 percent training; Fitting.ipynb, vcdm_genesis.fit.minimax_fit); the linear-programme solution is rounded to 12 significant digits
note: The released coefficients are the minimax optimum of the released training set (refit of 2026-09-18, vcdm_genesis.fit.minimax_fit on the training groups of the grouped split), rounded to 12 significant digits; the full-precision solution is recorded under lp_solution. They supersede the coefficients of release 1.0.0, which had been fitted to an earlier table; those are kept under previous_coefficients for reference and are not used anywhere.

lp_solution.note: full-precision output of the linear programme (scipy.optimize.linprog, HiGHS) on the training groups; rounding to the released 12-significant-digit values changes the full-grid maximum error by 1.5e-10 percent

validation.table: genesis_scan_table.csv (SHA-256 9da89f3f3e23cf4d178c2a154bb3f9e16dbd08f5b7effa48b6f7293442f9feda, LF-normalized bytes); Ps column SHA-256 of the assembled amplitude table cadf9dd55f086a7848712070fef6063990579e7a7df9217a0e05b7347106ad30
validation.split: grouped (d,kappa) split, seed 1234, 80 percent training (409600 / 102400 rows; data/fit_split_manifest.json)
validation.error_convention: table-relative: abs(S_fit/S_table - 1); not an integration-error estimate of the histories

previous_coefficients.note: coefficients of release 1.0.0, fitted to an earlier table and quoted in the paper at that release; table-relative errors above are against the released table; superseded by the refit of 2026-09-18, kept for reference and not used anywhere
